independentCalculation: Python pvlib==0.13.1: round(float(pvlib.iam.martin_ruiz(65,a_r=0.16)),4) for beam; round(float(pvlib.iam.martin_ruiz(59.7,a_r=0.16)),4) for sky; grazing ground IAM=0. The zero-tilt equivalent sky incidence 59.7 degrees is the intercept of Brandemuehl & Beckman (1980), Solar Energy 24(5),511-513, Ground incidence is 90 degrees. At 25 C the thermo-optic correction is zero; diffuse/ground irradiances are zero, so effective IAM is beam IAM. Loss=100*(1-IAM), rounded to 2 decimals and then 1 decimal for the contract. Rounding follows the public output precision. Unified-contract diagnostics use explicit zero-deposition, no-storm, no-snow, no-bifacial controls and explicit NOCT=45: zeros, unit daily soiling ratios and constant metadata are API zero-state assertions, not independent validation of those models. No application function or output was used for reference generation.
